text: On the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with him, on the authority of the Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him: A man visited a brother of his in another village, and God provided a king for him on his terrace (i.e., he made him sit on the road and watch him). When he came to him, he said: Where do you want? He said: I want a brother for me in this village. He said: Do you have a favor that you can bestow upon him? He said: No, except that I loved him for the sake of God Almighty. He said: For I am God’s messenger to you, that God has loved you as you loved him for him.
